title: Unlit drones hovering over 400 ft above Picatinny Arsenal

tellings.quote: These were lights off over 400 feet over Pikatini Arsenal, just sitting there.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in December 2024 he saw drones with their lights off, sitting still more than 400 feet above Picatinny Arsenal, a US Army research base in New Jersey. He tells it as something he saw himself, which, if true, would mean unknown craft were hovering freely over a military site.
